facts.text: I ride a bike, I collect action figures, and tonight I'm making Trish an egg salad sandwich. Poker night can wait.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Andy's real bike line is 'I hope you have a big trunk, 'cause I'm putting my bike in it.'.
facts.fix: I hope you have a big trunk, 'cause I'm putting my bike in it.

fix_note.text: I hope you have a big trunk, 'cause I'm putting my bike in it.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when Andy makes his famous egg salad sandwich.
facts.why: Andy tells his workmates he spent hours making egg salad on a Saturday, then had no bread and did not feel like eating it. He never makes a famous sandwich on screen.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Andy tells them about his egg salad with no bread.

facts.why: The egg salad is in the film, but Andy's story is that three hours of work left him with no bread and no appetite, so it was not perfect.

facts.text: Andy's drink for Survivor night with the neighbours.
facts.why: The Survivor night is real, set up with Joe and Sara in the stairwell. No source calls them neighbours, so name them.
facts.fix: Andy's drink for Survivor night with Joe and Sara.

vibe.verdict: Kelly Clarkson, the bike line and the egg salad cue print, but it is still a plain break room canteen with an orange poster.
